title: Rumblejack
extract:
Rumblejack is the Drifter's  Electricity dagger, possessing extreme status chance.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Electricity damage.
Two innate  polarities.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Stinging Thorn and  Pointed Wind stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Grants a 10% Movement Speed bonus when held (i.e. melee mode or quick melee).
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high total damage (300)
Very high follow through (0.9x)
Very high status chance (40.00%)

Very high total damage (600)
Very high follow through (0.9x)
Very high status chance (40.00%)

Very high total damage (900)
Very high follow through (0.9x)
Very high status chance (40.00%)

Acquisition
Rumblejack is given upon completion of The New War, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
Additional copies of Rumblejack can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for  100,000.

Notes
The Rumblejack sports a unique Finisher animation where the player jabs the opponent, dealing a guaranteed  Electricity proc before the actual finisher damage takes place.
The  Electricity proc cannot be converted to a combined damage type, or spread by Mecha Set.
This animation will play even on MOAs and Chargers, along with any enemy that uses their animations.

Trivia
The Rumblejack appears to be a Corpus Prova that was damaged and refurbished into a dagger.
